turns.query: I need in vitro to in vivo extrapolation (IVIVE) for hepatic clearance for 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs. I want predicted CLh (hepatic clearance mL/min/kg) and extraction ratio for each compound.
turns.responseText:
IVIVE Hepatic Clearance — Scales in vitro microsomal CLint to predicted human hepatic clearance for 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs using well-stirred and parallel-tube models.

Input: Compound data CSV with 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs (compound_id / CLint_uL_per_min_mg / molecular_weight columns)
Key steps:

PKNCA + well-stirred & parallel-tube models → CLint_microsomal scaled to CLh (mL/min/kg) per compound
Hepatic extraction ratio (EH) calculated from CLh vs. hepatic blood flow (QH = 20.7 mL/min/kg)
ivive_results.csv + clearance_summary.json generated with per-compound rankings


Expected output: ivive_results.csv (CLh + EH per TKI), clearance_summary.json (model comparison, well-stirred vs. parallel-tube), ranked HTML report

Decision gate: Flag compounds with EH > 0.7 as high-extraction (first-pass effect risk); CLh > 13 mL/min/kg indicates high hepatic clearance requiring dose adjustment consideration.

turns.responseText:
IVIVE Hepatic Clearance — BCR-ABL1 TKI Panel — Scales measured microsomal CLint to predicted human hepatic clearance (CLh) and extraction ratio (EH) for 4 TKIs using the well-stirred liver model.

Input: 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs — Dasatinib (CLint=220, fu_plasma=0.04), Bosutinib (CLint=60, fu_plasma=0.03), Imatinib (CLint=25, fu_plasma=0.04), Nilotinib (CLint=12, fu_plasma=0.01); QH=20.7 mL/min/kg, fu_mic=1.0
Key steps:

CLint scaling (μL/min/mg → mL/min/kg) with microsomal protein binding correction (fu_mic=1.0) → scaled CLint per compound
Well-stirred liver model: CLh = QH × (fu_plasma × CLint_scaled) / (QH + fu_plasma × CLint_scaled) → CLh (mL/min/kg) + EH per TKI
ivive_results.csv + clearance_summary.json compiled with per-compound rankings


Expected output: ivive_results.csv (CLh + EH for all 4 TKIs), clearance_summary.json (well-stirred model parameters + compound rankings), ranked HTML report with clearance funnel visualization

Decision gate: Flag compounds with EH > 0.7 as high-extraction (significant first-pass effect, formulation/route sensitivity); CLh > 13 mL/min/kg triggers high-clearance annotation requiring dose interval review.

turns.responseText:
BCR-ABL1 Campaign Safety-Potency Ranking — Ingests dual-assay IC50 data for 15 compounds and produces a composite potency-safety rank with hERG cardiac flags.

Input: 30-row assay CSV (15 compounds × 2 assay types: IC50_BCR_ABL1 in nM + hERG_IC50 in µM, dated 2026-03-15)
Key steps:

CSV parser + unit normalization → pivoted compound matrix (BCR-ABL1 nM, hERG µM, selectivity index = hERG IC50 / BCR-ABL1 IC50)
Composite scorer → weighted rank score (potency 60% + cardiac safety 40%), hERG flag applied at IC50 < 1 µM threshold
Ranked report generator → ranked_compounds.csv + HTML summary with flagged cardiac-risk compounds


Expected output: ranked_compounds.csv (composite score, potency rank, hERG flag per compound) + HTML report (visual ranking table, safety tier annotations) + ranking_summary.json (top hits + flagged compounds)

Decision gate: hERG IC50 < 1 µM → cardiac risk flag (CPD009 at 0.08 µM and CPD010 at 0.05 µM automatically ranked last regardless of BCR-ABL1 potency); BCR-ABL1 IC50 < 1 nM + hERG IC50 > 10 µM → Tier 1 candidate (CPD005 at 0.37 nM / hERG 0.9 µM borderline; CPD004 and CPD006 expected #1–2).
